k:貧.mnemonic: One shellfish (貝) coin, cut into part (分) after part so that everyone in the family gets a sliver. Poverty (poor).
k:貧.hint: One coin cut for the whole family.

k:償.mnemonic: The leader (亻) who broke your window hands over his own prize (賞) cup to make up for the damage. Reparation (make up for, recompense, redeem).
k:償.hint: His trophy for your broken window.

k:棒.mnemonic: For the observance (奉), a tree (木) is stripped to a straight shaft and carried upright at the head of the procession. Pole (rod, stick, cane).

k:臓.mnemonic: The body's own storehouse (蔵): the organs packed inside you, stocked with a month (月) of meals and working without a rest. Entrails (viscera, bowels).

k:勧.mnemonic: No arrow (矢), no power (力). You coax the turkey (隹) into the pen with a trail of corn and a kind voice. Persuade (recommend, advise, encourage).

k:尽.mnemonic: The flag (尸) hangs limp over the well, and the bucket brings up the very last drop (丶). Nothing is left. Exhaust (use up, run out of, deplete).

k:掘.mnemonic: Trapped under the flag (尸) of a collapsed tent, you claw at the ground with your fingers (扌) until you have made an exit (出). Dig (delve, excavate).

k:排.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) push the injustice (非) out through the door and bar it behind. We will have none of that in here. Repudiate (exclude, expel, reject).
k:排.hint: Pushed out and the door barred.

k:寛.mnemonic: From under his roof (宀) he can see (見) weeds coming up among the flowers (艹) and the children trampling both. He smiles and lets them be. Tolerant (leniency, generosity, relax).
k:寛.hint: Smiling at weeds and trampling children.

k:葬.mnemonic: In the evening (夕), twenty (廾) mourners each drop a spoon (匕) of earth into the ground, then lay flowers (艹) on top. Interment (bury, shelve).

k:爵.mnemonic: A stubborn (艮) nobleman with a hawk's claw (爪) on his crest. Everything inside his net (罒) of land is taxed down to the last measurement (寸). Baron (peerage, court rank).

k:緯.mnemonic: The weaver passes her thread (糸) from side to side across a strip of tanned hide (韋), left to right and back again, never up and down. Horizontal (woof, left & right, latitude).

k:雅.mnemonic: A turkey (隹) wearing a comb carved from ivory tusk (牙) fans its tail and bows to each guest in turn. Gracious (elegant, graceful, refined).

k:握.mnemonic: At the sushi shop (屋), the chef's fingers (扌) close around rice and fish and squeeze them into shape. Grip (hold, mould sushi).

k:添.mnemonic: Heaven (天) invariably (必) attaches a rainbow to the tail of every tsunami (氵) storm, a small extra that comes along with it. Annexed (accompany, suit, meet).
k:添.hint: Rainbow attached to the storm's tail.

k:綱.mnemonic: Thread (糸) twisted as thick as your arm, tying the ship to a post on the knoll (岡) above the harbour. Hawser (rope, cord, cable).

k:柔.mnemonic: A spear (矛) cut from the green wood of a young tree (木). It bends and flops instead of piercing anything. Tender (weakness, gentleness, softness).

k:栃.mnemonic: Shiny brown nuts drop from the overhang (厂) of a huge tree, and children chop (析) open the spiky husks to get at them. Horse chestnut.
k:栃.hint: Spiky husks under a big tree.

k:猫.mnemonic: The hound (犭) cannot find it. It is crouched among the flowers (艹) at the edge of the rice field (田), waiting without a twitch for mice. Cat.

k:僧.mnemonic: A leader (亻) of prayers who walks past the rice field (田) at the start of every day (日), head shaved, begging bowl in hand. Buddhist priest (monk).

k:摩.mnemonic: Pull a rough hemp (麻) rope through your hand (手) a few times and the skin is soon raw. Chafe (rub, polish, grind).

k:棟.mnemonic: At dawn (旦) the builders hang fruit (果) from the highest beam of the new roof as an offering, before any tiles go on. Ridgepole (ridge).
k:棟.hint: Fruit hung from the top beam.

k:俗.mnemonic: The leader (亻) comes down from the mountain temple into the valley (谷), where people gossip, haggle and laugh at rude jokes. Vulgar (customs, manners, worldliness).
k:俗.hint: Down from the temple to the gossip.

k:僚.mnemonic: You spend all day (日) beside them under the same leader (亻), sharing every job, big (大) and small (小). Colleague (official, companion).
k:僚.hint: Beside you all day at work.

k:塔.mnemonic: A tower rising from the soil (土) in stacked tiers, with flowers (艹) planted around the base to suit (合) it. Pagoda (tower, steeple).
k:塔.hint: Stacked tiers with a flowered base.

k:尚.mnemonic: A hall with a little window, and three sparks rising from its roof like incense smoke: a place that people look up to. Esteem (furthermore, still, yet).

k:軒.mnemonic: A car (車) parked under the eaves stays dry (干). One car, one home, and you count the dwellings in the row that way. Flats (eaves).
k:軒.hint: Counting homes by cars under eaves.

k:泰.mnemonic: After the observance (奉), the offering bowl of water (水) sits on the altar without a single ripple. Peaceful (calm, peace, easy).
k:泰.hint: Bowl of water without a ripple.

k:鎖.mnemonic: Links of gold (金) with a sparkle (⺌) on each, locked around the chest that holds the shellfish (貝) money. Chain (irons, connection).
k:鎖.hint: Gold links round the money chest.

k:滋.mnemonic: A tsunami (氵) of rich broth is poured over a tiny (幺) seedling and then over the tiny one beside it. Both shoot up, more and more. Nourishing (more & more, be luxuriant, planting).
